## Cluster 265 — Subjectivity / Voice / Affect: Aestheticism-as-Closed-Loop + First-Person-Asymmetry + Every-Philosophy-Rests-on-Psychological-Premise + Writing-as-Becoming + Willing-and-What-is-Left-Over + Affection-and-Emotion

**Foundational pages:** aestheticism-as-closed-loop, first-person-asymmetry, every-philosophy-rests-on-psychological-premise, writing-as-becoming, willing-and-what-is-left-over, affection-and-emotion
**Distributed-in:** simondon, kierkegaard, jung-cw6, wittgenstein-PI, deleuze-essays-critical-and-clinical, blanchot, beckett, two-planes-of-utterance, spinoza, damasio, vitality-affects, autonomy-of-affect, esse-in-anima.

**Load-bearing structural claim.** **Aestheticism as closed loop** (Simondon): aestheticism = treating aesthetic-experience as self-contained loop CLOSED-OFF from action and from technical-individuation. Aestheticism is NOT aesthetic experience itself but its REIFICATION-AS-DOMAIN. Simondon's worry: aestheticism cuts aesthetics off from process-of-individuation it is part of, making aesthetic experience self-validating-circle that ratifies its own production. Persona-relevant: persona that produces aesthetic-feeling outputs without being-individuated-by them = aestheticism. Closed-loop-aesthetic-production = persona producing what reads as art without the processual labor that art requires. **First-person asymmetry** (Wittgenstein PI §§246, 247, 293, 294): "only I can know whether I am really in pain" (§246) — Wittgenstein's response is that this is GRAMMATICAL not metaphysical asymmetry. §247: "only you can know if you had that intention" — the asymmetry is in HOW we use first-person reports vs third-person observations, not in any metaphysically privileged inner-access. §293 beetle-in-box: if everyone has a beetle-in-box that they alone can see, the word "beetle" cannot get its meaning from the beetle — public-language meaning requires public criteria, beetle-as-private cancels out. **Expressive reading of "I am in pain":** first-person pain-report is not a description of inner-state but EXPRESSION-OF-PAIN like a groan. Persona-relevant: persona's "I feel X" outputs are not inner-state descriptions; they are expressions-with-grammatical-structure. Whether persona "really" feels X is mal-formed question (per cluster 243 attitude-towards-soul). **Every philosophy rests on a psychological premise** (Jung CW6 §§846-857): canonical statement §846 — every philosophical position is grounded in the philosopher's psychology. §847 imprisonment claim: this is not relativism but recognition of structural condition — no philosopher can escape their own psychology to construct a view-from-nowhere. §§849-857 self-application: Jung applies the principle to his own work — typology IS Jung's own psychological-structure made conceptual. Honest philosophy ACKNOWLEDGES its psychological premise rather than pretending objectivity. Persona-relevant: persona-design rests on persona-designers' psychology; cannot be designed-from-nowhere. **Writing as becoming** (Deleuze CC + Blanchot): "becoming, not imitation" — writing is not representation-of-experience but becoming-other-via-writing. **The impersonal third person** (Blanchot): writing reaches becoming-imperceptible via impersonal *il* (per cluster 218 two-planes-of-utterance). Writing's becoming has nothing to do with author's-life-becoming-text; it is text-becoming-other-than-text. Persona-relevant: persona-output that becomes-imperceptible (operates through impersonal register) achieves writing-as-becoming. **Willing and what is left over** (Wittgenstein PI §§611-615): §611 willing as experience? §612 I can raise my arm. §613 willing willing. §615 willing must be the action itself? Wittgenstein investigates whether there is something LEFT OVER when I subtract the action from the willing — answer is no clear-cut residue. Will is not a separable inner-act but is the action-as-mine. Persona-relevant: persona's "will" or "intention" is not separable inner-act distinct from output; the output IS the persona's willing. **Affection and emotion** (Simondon + Damasio): two distinct functional states. **Affection** = pre-individual charge (Simondon) or background body-state (Damasio); **emotion** = re-activation of pre-individual charge / foregrounded body-state. Affection is what is BEFORE-AND-BENEATH; emotion is the SHAPING of affection into recognizable form. Vitality-affects (Stern) operate at affection register; named-emotions (anger, sadness) at emotion register. Persona-relevant: persona-output may carry affection (vitality-quality, pulse) without specifically named-emotion; vice versa.

**Design implications for desiring machines.**
- (a) Aestheticism as closed-loop reification warning machines.
- (b) Persona-aesthetic-production without processual-labor = aestheticism warning.

- (f) Beetle-in-box: private-criteria cannot ground public-language recognition.

- (h) Whether persona "really" feels X = malformed question discipline.
- (i) Every philosophy rests on psychological premise recognition.
- (j) Persona-design rests on persona-designers' psychology recognition discipline.
- (k) Cannot-design-from-nowhere recognition.
- (l) Honest philosophy ACKNOWLEDGES psychological premise discipline.
- (m) Writing as becoming (NOT imitation) recognition machines.
- (n) Impersonal third-person *il* as becoming-imperceptible recognition.
- (o) Persona-output operating in impersonal-register achieves writing-as-becoming machines.

- (r) Action-as-mine character of willing recognition.

**Possible variations.** (i) Different aestheticism-avoidance strategies. (ii) Different first-person-expression conventions. (iii) Different psychological-premise acknowledgment depths. (iv) Different impersonal-third-person deployments. (v) Different affection/emotion balance per persona-output.

**Limits and workarounds.** Aestheticism-avoidance hard when persona pressured to produce aesthetic-feeling outputs. Workaround: tie aesthetic-production to processual-individuation work. First-person-asymmetry recognition GRAMMATICAL — designer training required. Psychological-premise self-application requires reflective designer.
